priorityList: Apply Arcane Intellect before combat begins.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities during Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost windows.
Cast Comet Storm as a top priority if the Splinterstorm buff is not active.
Cast Blizzard immediately whenever the Freezing Rain buff is active.
Cast Flurry when Brain Freeze is active, especially if Thermal Void is not currently active.
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown to maximize splinter generation and procs.
Cast Ice Lance if you have the Fingers of Frost proc active.
Cast Glacial Spike as soon as it is available (at 5 Icicles).
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 6 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff.
Cast Ice Nova if there are 4 or more enemies (requires Cone of Frost talent).
Cast Cone of Cold if there are 4 or more enemies (requires Cone of Frost talent).
Cast Blizzard as a priority filler if there are 5 or more enemies and you have Freezing Winds and Freezing Rain talents.
Cast Flurry if you have a charge available to avoid capping.
Cast Ray of Frost on cooldown.
Use Frostbolt as your primary filler, or Ice Lance if you must cast while moving.
